name: TechnoRumble
description: Techno rumble kick processor: long reverb tail, sub LPF, drive, and transient-triggered sidechain duck. Feed a kick on AUDIO IN (NTS-3) or synth output (mkII). X/TIME = decay, Y/DEPTH = cutoff, Depth/MIX = dry/wet. DRIVE adds grit, PUMP ducks the rumble on each kick hit.

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: Reverb tail length (short rumble to long warehouse wash)

params.name: CUTOFF
params.detail: Low-pass cutoff (~40–500 Hz, lower = deeper sub)

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Sidechain duck depth on kick transients
